name: Mikage Kasumi
source:
President of the Cooking Club. Kasumi loves tea, poetry, and food. She spends most of her time relaxing and has very little interest in humans, so some people refer to her as a demon.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
